Method of Attack: Creating .args files with metadata for decryption
Impacted Systems: VMware ESXi servers (versions 7.x prior to ESXi70U1c-17325551, 6.7.x prior to ESXi670-202102401-SG, and 6.5.x prior to ESXi650-202102101-SG)
Attack Vector: Exploitation of CVE-2021-21974 via a heap overflow in the OpenSLP service
